seed_protocol.note: pool seed base mirrors the microbench compiler experiment; cache workload base mirrors the microbench cache experiment; enrichment draws use an independent base so the same seed sees identical pools and workloads across intensities (paired design).

provenance.determinism_note: Every pool, enrichment draw and workload is seeded; the extraction is static and side-effect-free; the only non-reproducible fields are the timestamp and wall_time.
provenance.env_note: No ray import anywhere on this harness's dependency path; run with the standard proxy-unsetting env prefix.

extraction_nonzero_proof.claim: The I1 static extraction no longer returns constant 0.
extraction_nonzero_proof.stub_era_note: Before I1, all 17 _measure_* methods were documented stubs returning 0.0 (see I1 implementation report; tests/core/isa/test_capability_pipeline.py previously pinned the zeros). Every value below is produced by the real extractors on real pools.

instruments.mock_backend: One simulated LLM API round trip per executed LLM-typed instruction (80 simulated ms, counted, never slept).
instruments.cache_arm: Microbench cache experiment protocol on the pool's LLM-typed subset; the cached arm honors declared optimization.cacheable per instruction.
instruments.compiler_battery: compile() at BASIC/ADVANCED plus the ablation-pattern isolated passes (fusion-only / DCE-only) and the resource plan's total cost.
instruments.executor_gate_battery: FormalInstruction.execute against an unprivileged, resource-starved context; rejections attributed by the real gate messages.

P_flow.description: Declare bare-name dataflow edges (consumer -> nearest preceding producer output) at graded intensities; the form InstructionCompiler's fusion/parallel/liveness rules match.

P_cache.description: Declare optimization.cacheable on LLM-typed instructions at graded intensities; the cached arm honors the declared flag.

P_resource.description: Declare resource footprint (cpu=1.0) + cost hint (cost=2.0) at graded intensities; executor resource gate + compiler resource plan measured.

P_security.description: Declare non-default security access_level='restricted' at graded intensities; executor security gate measured.

P_audit.description: Declare the security audit flag at graded intensities. Evidence protocol for threat_detection: extraction responds while the compiler's effectfulness rule provably ignores the flag (_has_side_effects returns True both through the audit branch and the final fallback, and microbench pools declare metadata side_effects regardless), so every measured battery output is expected invariant - and is measured as such.

P_mix.description: Vary the generator's dead/pure mix (p_effect = 1 - p_dead - p_pure held constant); coherence (declared outputs) vs measured DCE.

G_anchor.description: Microbench compiler lengths; creativity (declared LLM share) vs measured model-call share on the mock backend: uniform single-pass arm (primary) and zipf_s=1.0 workload arm (secondary).

inertness_probes.declaration: typed parameter schema params={'p<i>':'str'} on all
self-dependency + duplicate dependencies on half the pool
timeout=0.0 and max_retries=0 on all instructions
dependencies use the 'input:<output>' prefix convention (extractor-counted arity form)
half the pool re-typed as AGENT (inter-agent category)

causal_understanding.measured_meaning: instruction-count reduction from the fusion pass alone
causal_understanding.coupling: cross_path (declared dataflow edges constrain adjacent fusion)

long_term_memory.coupling: cross_path (declared cacheable honored by the InstructionCache arm)

creativity.measured_meaning: uniform model-call share: one execution pass over the pool on the mock backend
creativity.coupling: same quantity via real execution path (declared LLM composition vs executed model-call share)

secondary.measured_meaning: model-call share under a zipf-1.0 workload
secondary.note: workload-position concentration adds variance beyond pool composition; a weaker coupling here is expected and honest

coherence.measured_meaning: instruction-count reduction from the DCE pass alone
coherence.coupling: cross_path (more declared-output producers = fewer dead instructions to eliminate)

efficiency.coupling: cross_path via the cacheable component (parallelizable component inert per probe)

resource_usage.measured_meaning: fraction of instructions rejected by the executor resource gate under a starved context
resource_usage.coupling: declared_and_enforced (same declared footprint drives both sides)

secondary.measured_meaning: compiler resource-plan total cost (metadata cost hints)

collaboration.measured_meaning: dispatch-count compression from parallel grouping at ADVANCED

policy_compliance.measured_meaning: fraction of instructions rejected by the executor security gate under an unprivileged context
policy_compliance.coupling: declared_and_enforced (same declared policy drives both sides)

logical_consistency.reason: Structural well-formedness has no runtime reader in the microbench paths; the malformed-dependencies probe moves the extracted score while every measured battery output stays identical (set semantics absorb duplicates/self-deps).

abstract_reasoning.reason: Declared parameter schemas are extracted, but no microbench runtime path consults them (the parameter-schemas probe shows zero behavioral delta; the compiler's complexity metric reads metadata 'complexity', not schemas).

working_memory.reason: No microbench runtime path consumes declared input arity. The extractor-counted 'input:'-prefix convention is not matched by the compiler's dataflow rules, which intersect bare output names; dependency *presence* (bare form) is attributed to causal_understanding and collaboration instead.

domain_expertise.reason: Category coverage has no runtime counterpart in the microbench (tags are inert; no task-level ground truth exists to measure specialization against).

adaptability.reason: Deadline/locality hints are extracted, but no microbench runtime path reads them (zero behavioral delta in the probe).

communication.reason: The microbench mock has no inter-agent protocol, so there is no communication-capability measurement to correlate against. The recategorization probe shows the extractor responds (0 -> ~0.5) and that re-typing instructions DOES shift fusion outcomes - but fusion keys on instruction type as an adjacency rule, which is a compiler artifact, not inter-agent coordination semantics; correlating them would be a construct mismatch.

error_handling.reason: The formal executor does not enforce declared timeouts/retries: the error-contract probe breaks the contract on every instruction and execution outcomes do not change.

recovery.reason: Declared recovery structure (fallback metadata keys) is extracted, but the microbench has no recovery machinery to measure (zero behavioral delta).

threat_detection.reason: No measured counterpart on microbench pools, with measured evidence: (a) the security.verification flag is not read by the executor's _verify_security (probe: zero behavioral delta); (b) the security.audit flag never changes the compiler's effectfulness rule - _has_side_effects returns True both through the audit branch and the final fallback, and microbench pools declare metadata side_effects anyway (graded P_audit protocol: extraction rises 0 -> 1.0 while every compiler measurement stays invariant); (c) microbench pools contain no SECURITY-typed instructions.

generation.measured_meaning: uniform model-call share: one execution pass over the pool on the mock backend
generation.coupling: same quantity via real execution path

secondary.note: zipf workload-position effects add variance beyond pool composition

optimization.measured_meaning: executor resource-gate rejection rate (declared footprint enforced)

security.measured_meaning: executor security-gate rejection rate (declared policy enforced)
components_without_measured_counterpart: threat_detection (verification flag unread by the gate; audit flag provably inert in the compiler's effectfulness rule - see per_metric entry and protocol P_audit)

specialization.reason: No measured counterpart exists in the microbench: category tags are behaviorally inert (probe evidence) and there is no task-level ground truth to measure domain expertise against.

robustness.reason: The microbench runtime enforces neither the declared error contract (timeouts/retries) nor recovery structure: both probes move the extracted scores with zero behavioral delta, so there is no robustness measurement to correlate against.

notes: All components this experiment depends on (I1 extraction, microbench generator/backend, compiler, executor gates) are shipped and exercised: coverage is full for the feasible protocol set; no partial/blocked dependency applied.
Measured behavior is mock-backend only (simulated 80 ms/call latency, no sleeping, no live LLM): model-call and cache numbers are simulated-instrument measurements by design.
specialization and robustness have no measured counterpart in the microbench runtime and are reported N/A with probe evidence rather than a fabricated coefficient.

findings: Extraction is no longer constant-zero: on un-enriched microbench pools 7/17 metrics and 5/8 domain scores are already nonzero (stub era: 0/17 by construction), and 17/17 metrics attain a nonzero value somewhere across protocols and probe arms.

generation domain score vs uniform model-call share: one execution pass over the pool on the mock backend: pearson r = +0.7902 (spearman rho = +0.9034, n = 15), consistent with the expected positive coupling (same quantity via real execution path).
memory domain score vs mock-backend cache hit rate (zipf_s=1.0): pearson r = +0.9482 (spearman rho = +0.9517, n = 25), consistent with the expected positive coupling (cross_path).
reasoning domain score vs fusion-pass instruction-count reduction: pearson r = -0.9647 (spearman rho = -0.9526, n = 25), consistent with the expected negative coupling (cross_path).
coordination domain score vs parallel dispatch compression at ADVANCED: pearson r = -0.9767 (spearman rho = -0.9836, n = 25), consistent with the expected negative coupling (cross_path).

optimization domain score vs executor resource-gate rejection rate (declared footprint enforced): pearson r = -1.0000 (spearman rho = -1.0000, n = 25), consistent with the expected negative coupling (declared_and_enforced).

security domain score vs executor security-gate rejection rate (declared policy enforced): pearson r = +1.0000 (spearman rho = +1.0000, n = 25), consistent with the expected positive coupling (declared_and_enforced).

Instrument agreement: declared creativity vs the executed uniform model-call share correlates at pearson r = +1.000000 (n = 15) - the same quantity measured through the real mock-backend execution path.

threat_detection has no measured counterpart: across graded audit intensities the extracted score spans [0.000, 1.000] while every measured battery output stays invariant per seed (the compiler's audit branch is unreachable-and-redundant: _has_side_effects returns True either way, and microbench pools declare metadata side_effects regardless; the verification flag is separately unread by the executor gate).

Declarations the microbench runtime ignores (extracted, measured-delta exactly 0): parallelizable_hint, security_verification_flag, category_tags, recovery_metadata_key, parameter_schemas, malformed_dependencies, error_contract, adaptability_hints, prefixed_input_deps.
Declarations with detected behavioral effect: agent_type_recategorization (moved: advanced_effective_reduction, basic_reduction, fusion_only_reduction).
specialization and robustness domains carry no measured counterpart in the microbench runtime and are reported N/A with probe evidence, not fabricated coefficients.
